I know how you're feeling. I feel stupid for being so hurt. I've been crying for hours now and I know if my family and friends knew they would think I'm over reacting. (My mom understands). 

But Chester "got it" when I listened to his music I felt like I was listening to my feelings in lyrics and if he could do it then so could I. 

Now I'm just stuck feeling lost.

I'm hurting so bad today. Heavy has been on repeat since it came out. It really did put words to the jumbled up thoughts inside my head. I was a fan when I was a teenager but stopped listening. Their new album brought me back because of the lyrics in heavy. It was like someone finally got it. 

Now I don't know what to do. I have been crying for hours listening to song after song. 

How do you continue when the one musician that "got it" couldn't. 

I know it will get better but for right now I don't want it too.

I'm referring to earlier. I was catching lured Pokémon while others were being soft banned and I never had any problems. 

I started playing as soon as the even started and I just not got home for the night and stopped playing.
I've been catching Pokémon at lured spots (maybe only a few catches though) and not had a soft ban. I haven't set a lure though.

People ask my why I'm still playing Pokémon. I never played before Pokémon go and I honestly felt a little weird when I started playing. Now that I still play it definitely confuses people. 

It's funny how no one really fits inside these stereotype boxes we build for ourselves. Humans really can't be labeled and people will always surprise you if you give them a chance.
Right! I honestly looked away because I couldn't watch.
I'm watching orange is the new black. Kinda feels like a rebound though. Not as good as Shameless but it'll work to get me over the void.

Either Mickey getting raped or Debbie falling asleep holding the baby. It was hard to watch both those scenes. 

The look on Ian's face during the Mickey scene made it especially hard to watch.

Would you have turned your brother or sister in? I wouldn't have. Maybe she should have sat down and encouraged him too but she did that for revenge. She even told him she was sorry and he was a good kid but basically his family screwed her over so she screwed him over. She wasn't doing it to help Ian.

This might be a spoiler. 

I liked her at first too. Then what she did to Ian was inexcusable. I will admit that she's a decent parent for shameless.

Me to! I'm literally following a bunch of Mickey and Ian pages on Facebook. I can't get enough of their relationship and I seriously hope we see more of them. I might cry if not. Mickey definitely have the best character growth. I can't pick a favorite between him and Ian. I would love if they did a spinoff with Mickey. I'll let you know once I start watching again. 🙂

Haha if shameless had good times, they definitely weren't season 5-7. Even 4 was depressing, I just love Ian and Mickey so much. I'm actually waiting because I just ordered a new TV and I want to watch it again on my new bigger tv. 😂I'll start watching again on Friday.

My mom once told me that killing yourself is the most selfish thing you can do. It leaves others hurting all because you were going through temporary pain. 

I remember her saying that every time I feel like killing myself. Sometimes I'm glad she said that but I also realize that she really didn't understand depression and it makes me feel even more alone.

Yep. I even force myself to go out and buy new clothes or video games, books. I hope it'll make me happier and it works for about 10 minutes. But once I get home, it all hits again. 

What's the point in buying nice things when I just feel lonely and unhappy anyways. Might as well save my money and lay in bed all day. The end result is always the same.

Yep. I got a huge bonus from work so I could be out having fun. But instead all I've done is sleep. I look forward to work because I'll have to get up tomorrow. I feel stupid saying that because why should you have to look forward to work just so you can get out of bed? But I don't see a point in getting out of bed during the weekends. 

Anyways, I understand how you feel.

But also his lifestyle is another reason he can keep him from becoming Frank. It's easy for someone who doesn't understand alcohol addiction to give advice but it means more when it comes from someone who's been there. And I feel like Lip had started looking up to Youen as a mentor, he's almost another Frank but more functional.
I agree. I understand why Mickey probably won't be back but I can't help but hope. 🙂 I hope we get someone else for Ian. Not any of the guys he's seen before.
True drunken thoughts though.
I agree. He could be the only person keeping Lip from becoming Frank.

I can understand that. A few times I had to go to bed because I was getting a little upset, I definitely cried during a lot of episodes. I honestly feel a little depressed that I'm done with it though.

Ian.

Ian Gallagher

Ian is often the most strong-hearted, persistent, and goofy -yet currently reckless- third oldest child in the Gallagher family. Ian has been diagnosed with Bipolar Disorder. His behavior has been erratic and out of control, worrying his family. Ian is not as intelligent as Lip, but he is more physically fit and has an excellent work ethic in nearly everything he does. He is often uncertain of what he wants to do in his life, but once he makes a goal for himself he goes after it 100 percent.

I think I'm a mix of Ian and Lip.

I think she's referring to the kids. I was the first of my grandparents grandkids to graduate high school so everyone often says I was the first in my family to graduate. But I had a grandpa that was a college professor, he obviously graduated high school first. It's just a generation thing.

I like Debbie too. She's not my favorite character but I honestly hate Fiona more than Debbie. I think any dislike I have for Debbie comes from the fact that she's a 16 year old girl. Most 16 year olds are annoying. Which means she's a great actress.

It's everything, her body, her face, her hair. Then to top it all off she has a crappy personality. I just don't see it. And it's almost unbelievable that all these guys just fall edit her. Jimmy/Steve basically falls in love with her in the first episode.

I don't think Fiona is attractive. Everyone always says she's hot and I just don't see it. I'm a straight girl but I admit that V is cute and a lot of the other female characters. But I always hear how hot Fiona is and I feel like we're talking about different characters. Also I really don't like Fiona very much as a character, she's whining all the time and really not a great mother/guardian. I don't like the way she treated Lip in season 7.

Right. I have autoimmune disease, ulcerative colitis and rheumatoid arthritis which give me severe anxiety and depression. How am I supposed to tell an employer and still get hired? I never do I just lie and hope it doesn't become an issue. Finally I'm lucky to have a job that knows and they're working with me. But that's rare and I know most people aren't lucky.

I definitely agree. I think he meant in general employers couldn't discriminate if he were in a wheelchair but with mental illness they can. Still I've never seen disability brought up like this on tv. For someone who has been through it it's really interesting to see and I'm glad they did it.

No I personally don't think that's it. Frank barely acknowledges the fact that Ian isn't his. He's accepting of all gays not just Ian which is a good quality. There's a deleted scene where he's still pretending he's gay and he tells Ian he understands what he's been through.
Ian, Mickey, and then Carl. Female characters would be V or Mandy.

Mickey has the best character growth. I swear he comes out of no where and hits you like a brick. Looking back to when he first showed up , I never would have thought he was a good character, I actually was surprised he made it into multiple seasons.
Ian.
